category_edits.rationale: Tie input and output item embeddings across all four category models to improve statistical efficiency while preserving unit normalization, embedding width and zero padding. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so checkpoint loading restores the tied architecture consistently. GRU, features, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

change_summary: Share one unit-normalized item embedding table between history inputs and output candidates in each category’s single GRU4Rec model.
